title: echinochloa crus-galli subsp. edulis
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli subsp. edulis, commonly known as Broomcorn Millet or Barnyard Millet, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Echinochloa crus-galli subsp. edulis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
